title: What House Dust Is Really Made Of
hook: The dust in your house is not dirt from outside.
script: The dust in your house is not dirt from outside. A lot of it is dead skin cells, and you shed tens of thousands every minute. And it never stops, not even while you sleep. So where do all those cells go? They drift off your skin and settle on shelves, floors and sofas. You replace your entire outer layer of skin every two to four weeks. Over a year, that adds up to about a pound of skin. So when you wipe a shelf, what are you wiping up? A little bit of yourself, and your house is slowly filling up with you.
